resources.string: Floating profiler: live W/mA/V + avg-mA plot, battery, CPU per-core freq+load, GPU, temps, network, memory — drawn over other apps.
Overlay permission: MISSING — tap the button above
Usage Access: granted — samples tag the foreground app
Usage Access: MISSING — recordings tag apps as unknown
Recording: ON — samples save to Sessions
Overlay: RUNNING — drag it anywhere, tap ▲/▼ to collapse

Notes: no root, no special permissions — everything comes from public APIs + world-readable sysfs. CPU load uses HardwarePropertiesManager with /proc/stat fallback; GPU is best-effort sysfs. Blocked nodes show N/A (see logcat -s PerfOverlay:D).
